t: 1588年4月12日的"指示"被颁布,被普遍认为是荷兰共和国的正式成立.
te: The Instruction of 12 April 1588 was enacted, which is widely regarded as the formal establishment of the Dutch Republi…
dz: 1588年4月12日的"指示"被颁布,被普遍认为是荷兰共和国的正式成立.
de: The Instruction of 12 April 1588 was enacted, which is widely regarded as the formal establishment of the Dutch Republic.

t: 第四次十字军东征的十字军突破了君士坦丁堡的城墙并进入了城市,他们于次日完全占领了城市.
te: The Crusaders of the Fourth Crusade breach the walls of Constantinople and enter the city, which they completely occupy…
dz: 第四次十字军东征的十字军突破了君士坦丁堡的城墙并进入了城市,他们于次日完全占领了城市.
de: The Crusaders of the Fourth Crusade breach the walls of Constantinople and enter the city, which they completely occupy the following day.

t: 得到安提洛克王子雷纳尔德(英语:Raynald of Châtillon)的呈文后,拜占庭皇帝…
te: Having received the submission of the prince of Antioch, Raynald of Châtillon, Byzantine Emperor Manuel I Komnenos ente…
dz: 得到安提洛克王子雷纳尔德(英语:Raynald of Châtillon)的呈文后,拜占庭皇帝曼努埃尔一世·科姆内诺斯(英语:Manuel I Komnenos)成功入驻安提洛克城.
de: Having received the submission of the prince of Antioch, Raynald of Châtillon, Byzantine Emperor Manuel I Komnenos enters triumphantly the city of Antioch.

t: 诺森布里亚国王埃德温由约克主教保利努斯皈依基督教.
te: King Edwin of Northumbria is converted to Christianity by Paulinus, Bishop of York.
dz: 诺森布里亚国王埃德温由约克主教保利努斯皈依基督教.
de: King Edwin of Northumbria is converted to Christianity by Paulinus, Bishop of York.

t: 后被提升为西罗马帝国皇帝.
te: Anthemius is elevated to Emperor of the Western Roman Empire.
dz: 后被提升为西罗马帝国皇帝.
de: Anthemius is elevated to Emperor of the Western Roman Empire.

t: 沙普尔一世与他的父亲阿尔达希尔一世一起成为了萨珊帝国的共主.
te: Shapur I becomes co-emperor of the Sasanian Empire with his father Ardashir I.
dz: 沙普尔一世与他的父亲阿尔达希尔一世一起成为了萨珊帝国的共主.
de: Shapur I becomes co-emperor of the Sasanian Empire with his father Ardashir I.
